'''Exar Kun Vengence Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Exar Kun (GPN)|Exar Kun]]
* '''Published:''' 14 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS Kun DS 2003 Vengence.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

you thought that attrition was annoying before but not this bad

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

what I first do is I get out Greedo and Beedo from reserve deck and the two docking bays.  Than I move over Prince Xizor to spaceport docking bay to flip the objective.  I deploy the Vigos to Coruscant while I am still there.  I than try to wat for my opponent to deploy charachters than I deploy bounties on them and go and capture them.  I use precision targeting the naboo Blasters and inconsequential losses so that I can hit people and they dont satisfy attrition and than I can forfeit the blasters to used pile and my objective also majorly adds to the attrition.  I than get out IT-O and bring my people back to clud city and start force draining like crazy using IT-Os new game textI also use the space to just force drain some
